description: Returns metrics and request samples for a domain and endpoint observed by a Bugfender app.

app_id.description: The public app ID (e.g. 5X3c4veRGV) from list_apps

device_udid.description: Filter network requests to a specific device UDID.

endpoint.description: Endpoint path to inspect. Defaults to '/' when omitted.

os.description: Filter by operating system name (e.g. iOS, Android).

sample_page_size.description: Page size for sample requests. Max 100.

name: get_network_details

data.description: Tool-specific result data, present when ok is true.

error.description: Error details, present when ok is false.

hint.description: Optional recovery guidance that does not expose credentials.

ok.description: True on success and false on failure.

pagination.description: Pagination state for retrieving more results.

title: Get Network Request Details
